description: Monthly IBM adjusted prices, broad US market excess returns and matched risk-free returns for rolling CAPM.

stock.units: USD, adjusted for dividends and splits

market_and_rf.source: Kenneth R. French Data Library, Fama/French 3 Factors
market_and_rf.market: CRSP value-weighted US market return minus the one-month risk-free return (Mkt-RF)
market_and_rf.RF: One-month risk-free return; source monthly return, not annual yield
market_and_rf.conversion: Original percentage returns divided by 100 in the CSV

date_labels: Calendar month-end; Stock_observation_date retains the actual source trading date.
base_month: December 1999, used only to calculate the January 2000 stock return
transformations: Stock_excess = Stock_return - RF; dividends are not added again
Market_excess is already Mkt-RF; RF is not subtracted again
Both regression returns multiplied by 100, giving percentage-point units
exclusions: All months after December 2025 excluded, including the partial latest source month.

model.covariance: HAC, Bartlett weights, 3 monthly lags, n/(n-2) correction, approximate t inference

scope: Teaching notebook distributed with its matched monthly data; other exploratory notebooks are separate.
